messages:
Alex (Sales): FYI — Acme asked for a 3-week POC. Need to lock scope, success KPIs, and security artifacts. Can we sketch acceptance criteria today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria (Solutions): Yep. Proposed scope: 3 flows — 1) customer support triage (classification + routing), 2) summarization for agent view, 3) snippet search/rerank for KB.
Maria (Solutions): Eval plan: curated prompt sets (50 prompts each), automated BLEU/ROUGE + human spot-check for hallucinations. Acceptance = automated pass rate >= 88% and <5% critical hallucinations on spot-check.
Jin (ProdEng): For perf targets, propose p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350ms for single-turn generation with our small-medium model on dedicated GPU. If they need <50ms we push to a quantized variant or dedicated pool.
Jin (ProdEng): Cost projection: based on their estimated 25k tokens/day during POC -> ~750k tokens total. Rough hosted cost w/ caching: $0.30 per 1k tokens -> ~$225. If they want Dedicated for isolation it's a different quote (monthly commit).
Sam (Acme): Can you confirm exact latency numbers we should include in the SOW? Our SLA at the moment is 200ms p95 for critical flows.
Maria (Solutions): We can commit to p95 350ms in hosted POC as long as load is within our test plan. To hit 200ms p95 we recommend Dedicated with pre-warmed workers — estimate 2-3x cost.
Priya (Security): Need to collect upfront: SOC2 report, encryption at rest+in transit details, data retention policy, KMS integration support, and a standard security questionnaire. Also ask: will training data be sent back to Redwood? (Acme)
Sam (Acme): No training data — only ephemeral request/response logs for debugging. Retention: 30 days, then delete.
Priya (Security): Ok. We still need contractual language for no-model-training and confirm we can purge logs on request. Also: SSO (SAML) and SCIM for the console?
Alex (Sales): They'll require SSO yes. Add that to the SOW. Also include a list of required artifacts for security review and a target turnaround of 3 business days to return the questionnaire.
Jin (ProdEng): Technical checklist for POC engineers: model variant, max seq len, batching window, KV-cache enabled, and fallback policy. Quick sample config:
```
model: redwood-small-v1
max_seq_len: 1024
batch_window_ms: 20
kv_cache: true
fallbacks: [redwood-small-quant]
```
Maria (Solutions): Eval harness command for their test set: 
```
python run_eval.py --prompts acme_poc_prompts.csv --metrics rouge,exact_match --p95-target 0.35
```
Maria (Solutions): Success criteria summary to include in SOW:
- Functional: all 3 flows implemented and demoed
- Quality: automated metric pass >=88% and human pass >=90%
- Performance: p50 <80ms, p95 <350ms (hosted) or p95 <200ms (dedicated option)
- Cost: total POC hosting estimate <$500 (hosted).
- Security: SOC2, encryption, SSO/SCIM, data purge clause present
Alex (Sales): Blockers we should flag now: legal sign-off on data purge, security questionnaire turnaround, and dedicated capacity quoting lead time (~2 weeks).
Priya (Security): I'll own the questionnaire follow-up. Please send me their InfoSec point and the initial answers by EOD.
Sam (Acme): We'll get InfoSec contact + initial questionnaire answers in 24 hours.
Deploy Bot: Deployment scheduled: poc-env-redwood -> 2025-11-10T14:00Z (automated).
Maria (Solutions): Next steps: I'll draft SOW snippet and the acceptance table, Jin will add the deploy/config notes, Priya will attach security checklist. Aim to circulate draft by tomorrow EOD.
Alex (Sales): Perfect — thanks everyone. If we hit these targets and their human eval looks good we can convert to Dedicated quoting. :thumbsup:
